name: youtube
author: Waph1
title: YouTube Video & Audio
description: YouTube videos, audio and playlists with automatic merging. Requires Gopeed 2.0.0-beta.3 or later.

settings.name: downloadMode
settings.title: Download Mode
settings.description: Video + audio is merged automatically into MP4. Separate files and audio-only downloads do not need FFmpeg.

settings.name: videoQuality
settings.title: Video Quality
settings.description: Maximum resolution on the shorter side (also for Shorts). Choose the highest available at or below the cap; if none exists, use the lowest available.

settings.name: audioQuality
settings.title: Audio Quality
settings.description: Select an existing audio stream; no upsampling or MP3 conversion. Numeric values choose the nearest available bitrate. MP4 video uses AAC audio.

settings.name: askQuality
settings.title: Choose Quality On Download
settings.description: Offer video+audio and audio-only choices in the confirmation file list. Gopeed selects ALL by default: deselect all, then select the version you want. Video entries use your default audio quality. Playlist entries are quality caps, not promises of availability.

settings.name: playlistFromVideoUrl
settings.title: Download Playlist From Video Link
settings.description: When a video link also contains a playlist (watch?v=...&list=...), download the whole playlist instead of the single video.

settings.name: playlistLimit
settings.title: Playlist Limit
settings.description: Maximum playable entries to list; 0 loads the whole playlist. Streams are prepared only when each download starts.

settings.name: audioContainer
settings.title: Audio File Format
settings.description: For audio-only and separate files. M4A = AAC; WebM = usually Opus. Highest means highest within this format. No transcoding.

settings.name: cookie
settings.title: YouTube Cookie (Optional)
settings.description: Optional Cookie request header for your YouTube account. Leave empty for public videos. Never share this value in logs or issues.
